title: Find and apply materials
summary: Load source assets, search materials, preview them, and apply one to the selection or the next shape.
outcome: The active material is available for drawing and the intended selected surfaces show it.

sections.title: Choose an active material

steps.title: Load a source
steps.text: Show the asset browser, click Browse…, and choose the raw assets or texture folder that contains the materials you need.

steps.title: Find a material
steps.text: Search by name. Toggle In Use to limit the list to names already used by this map, or choose a saved Collection. Turn on Preview to inspect the selected material.

steps.title: Apply or draw
steps.text: Click a material tile, or select it and press Enter or Space. It becomes the active material; with supported map surfaces selected, the browser applies it to those surfaces. Draw a new brush or terrain to use the active material on new geometry.

tips: If a tile lacks a usable preview or an image cannot be read, correct the asset source and refresh its readiness before applying it.

sections.title: Manage a large material set

steps.title: Save frequent choices
steps.text: Use Collection > Manage… to maintain favorite collections.

steps.title: Replace repeated use
steps.text: Use Find / replace… when a material name should change across existing map surfaces. Review the match and replacement choice before applying.

tips: Choose the material before drawing geometry; changing the active material alone does not repaint unrelated surfaces.
